title: Polished Chrome Towel Bar, 18-Inch Wall Mount Straight Bar In Solid Brass, Allied Brass
description:
Stop draping towels over doors and countertops—add a dedicated, space-saving towel storage point with a wall mount towel bar designed for daily bathroom use in Polished Chrome, which delivers a bright, mirror-like sheen that coordinates effortlessly with chrome faucets and modern fixtures. This Carolina Collection piece features a straight bar profile crafted from brass, with concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished appearance.

- Keep hand towels or bath towels organized and easy to grab
- Concealed mounting hardware keeps the look polished
- Wall-mounted design is an ideal use of space in compact baths
- Coordinate a classic look with matching Carolina Collection pieces
- Choose from multiple designer finish options available

Specs: Towel bar / towel rack / towel holder / towel rail. 18 in center-to-center. Overall dimensions: 20 in L x 2 in D x 3.5 in H. Bar diameter: 0.75 in. Weight capacity: 10 lb. Mounting: wall mount, concealed screw hardware. Included: towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware (screws #8 x 1 1/4"). Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty.
